response.sql: WITH member_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total_members AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM member_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT mc.link_to_major, mc.member_count, CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / tm.total as share FROM member_counts mc CROSS JOIN total_members tm), avg_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares), above_avg_groups AS (SELECT ws.member_count, ws.share, asv.avg_share FROM with_shares ws CROSS JOIN avg_share_value asv WHERE ws.share > asv.avg_share) SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_above_average FROM above_avg_groups
